capacitance_ff_um.source: Existing plots/config.py and task brief Section 6

resistance_ohm_um.source: Existing plots/config.py and task brief Section 6

tile_um.source: Su2025 virtual core size + benchmark common-substrate requirement

vdd.notes: A common wire-energy comparison voltage, not an extracted 22 nm HBS supply.

wire_activity.notes: Same selected wire activity for external links and Our Tree; sweep if needed.

output_energy_fraction.notes: E(bits,f)=bits*E1*((1-alpha)+alpha*f). Transfer of the fitted 40 nm asynchronous ratio to 22 nm HBS is not separately characterized. Applied to HBS only by default; xpipes retains its unsplit reported energy/bit coefficient.
output_energy_fraction.source: Su2024 Table I(b) branch/unicast ratio transferred to Table III asynchronous base energy

output_fraction_sensitivity.source: Zero-output-cost lower bound and Su2024 Table I(b) endpoint/midpoint ratios

filter_energy_pj.notes: Not an assertion that filtering is free; total energy must also be reported for positive costs.

macro_search_pj.notes: Full referenced macro search. Su2025 does not disclose how its illegal-event filter is dimensioned.

sensitivity_pj.source: Benchmark sensitivity: transport only; hypothetical 40 x 10 array; referenced 128 x 64 macro

core_size_mm.notes: Each virtual core occupies 1 x 1 mm^2.

endpoints.source: Su2025 Section IV, manuscript p3 / PDF p4

forward_latency_ns.notes: Transfer from 22 nm Proposed Multicast, not a measured HBS delay.
forward_latency_ns.source: Su2024 Table III; Su2025 says same switch microarchitecture with different route logic

packet_bits.source: 10-bit tag + 8-bit HBS routing field, Su2025 Section IV-A

router_energy_pj_bit.notes: 22 nm Proposed Multicast switch energy proxy for HBS routing logic.

service_interval_ns.notes: EXPLICIT MIXED-POINT PROXY: 40 nm, post-synthesis, 128-bit, five-slot input rate transferred to 22 nm, 18-bit, one-slot HBS. No technology scaling. Sensitivity required.
service_interval_ns.source: Reciprocal of Su2024 Table I(b) 534 Mpacket/s

service_sensitivity_ns.notes: These alternatives are not additional measurements.
service_sensitivity_ns.source: Benchmark sensitivity design around the recovered absolute-rate proxy

baseline_area_um2.source: Su2024 Table I(b), Baseline Multicast row

baseline_energy_pj_bit.notes: Measured for five-flit packets; optimistic for single-flit traffic.
baseline_energy_pj_bit.source: Su2024 Table I(b), Baseline Multicast row

baseline_header_latency_ns.source: Su2024 Table I(b), Baseline Multicast row: 1629 psec

baseline_packet_rate_mpps.source: Su2024 Table I(b), Baseline Multicast row

branch_fraction.notes: A fitted ratio at 40 nm / 128 bits, not a measured 22 nm fanout coefficient.
branch_fraction.source: Midpoint of Su2024 Table I(b) branch increment divided by unicast energy

forward_latency_ns.source: Su2024 Table I(b): 1934 psec header latency

input_slots.notes: Circular FIFO, not the one-slot 22 nm point.

packet_bits.source: Su2024 Table I(b), manuscript p9 / PDF p10

packet_rate_mpps.source: Su2024 Table I(b), Proposed Multicast row

router_energy_pj_bit.source: Su2024 Table I(b), Unicast Energy column

service_interval_ns.notes: Pipelining permits initiation faster than end-to-end header latency at this five-slot characterization point.
service_interval_ns.source: 1000 / Su2024 Table I(b) packet rate in Mpacket/s

async_area_um2.source: Su2024 Table III, manuscript p13 / PDF p14

sync_clock_ns.notes: Inferred one clock period from explicit single-cycle description; no separate frequency is listed.
sync_clock_ns.source: Su2024 Section XI single-cycle switch + Table III latency

area_ratio_to_fbs.source: One minus 29.0% reduction, Su2025 Section IV-A

area_ratio_to_symbol.source: One minus 9.4% reduction, Su2025 Section IV-A

illegal_packet_ratio_to_symbol_upper_bou.notes: Strict upper bound, not an exact ratio.

routing_energy_ratio_to_fbs.source: One minus 55.7% reduction, Su2025 Section IV-B

routing_energy_ratio_to_symbol.source: One minus 48.1% reduction, Su2025 Section IV-B

total_energy_ratio_to_fbs.source: One minus 52.6% reduction, Su2025 Section IV-B

total_energy_ratio_to_symbol.source: One minus 49.1% reduction, Su2025 Section IV-B

clock_ns.source: Su2024 Table III + Section XI single-cycle description

integrated_link_extra_cycles.notes: Primary interpretation absorbs the short common-model wire into the one-cycle hop budget. The paper does not establish physical timing slack for this integration.
integrated_link_extra_cycles.source: Benchmark mesh timing assumption; Su2024 does not specify link register boundaries

packet_bits.notes: Table III does not specify a fixed datapath width; 26 is the minimum logical single-flit width. 32-bit sensitivity should be supported.
packet_bits.source: Benchmark exact 16-core mask + Su2025 10-bit source tag

registered_link_extra_cycles.notes: Alternative explicitly adds a link capture cycle after each switch traversal.
registered_link_extra_cycles.source: Benchmark conservative registered-link sensitivity; not reported by Su2024

service_interval_ns.source: Su2024 Section XI says full throughput with two-slot stall/go buffers
